name: comment
description: Add a comment (Markdown) to a task.

name: create_task
description:
Create a task in a project, with an optional Markdown description, labels (existing ones
unless create_missing_labels is true), assignees by username, priority 0-5 and due date.

arguments.name: create_missing_labels
arguments.desc: Create labels that do not exist yet. Default false: an unknown label is an error.

arguments.name: labels
arguments.desc: Label titles. Labels must exist unless create_missing_labels is true.

arguments.name: priority
arguments.desc: Priority 0 to 5 (0 unset, 1 low, 2 medium, 3 high, 4 urgent, 5 do now).

arguments.name: project
arguments.desc: Project to create the task in (title or id).

name: get_task
description:
Read one task: every field, the description as text, and its comments with author and
date (the 50 most recent; long text is cut).

name: list_projects
description: List projects with id, title, parent project and number of open tasks (up to 100).

name: list_tasks
description:
List tasks, open ones by default, sorted by priority then due date. Filters: project,
label, done, due_before, search; limit up to 100.

arguments.name: done
arguments.desc: Done tasks instead of open ones. Default false (open tasks).

arguments.name: due_before
arguments.desc: Only tasks due before this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO-8601).

arguments.name: project
arguments.desc: Only tasks in this project (title or id).

arguments.name: search
arguments.desc: Text to search for in titles and descriptions.

name: update_task
description:
Change a task: any of title, description (Markdown, replaces the old one), done,
priority, due ("none" clears it), add_labels / remove_labels, add_assignees /
remove_assignees (usernames), or move it to another project.

arguments.name: add_labels
arguments.desc: Label titles to add. Labels must exist unless create_missing_labels is true.

arguments.name: create_missing_labels
arguments.desc: Create labels in add_labels that do not exist yet. Default false.

arguments.name: description
arguments.desc: New description in Markdown (replaces the old one).

arguments.name: due
arguments.desc: New due date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO-8601), or "none" to clear it.

arguments.name: project
arguments.desc: Move the task to this project (title or id).
